title: Medicinal Pill
body:
Syntax: craft pill medicine <level>  |  examine <pill>  |  use <pill>  |  eat <pill>

Description: Bukijutsu level 25+ crafts one pill from Medicinal Herbs. Choose a level from 1 to your own level (max 250); it is saved in item data and shown by examine, not in the name. Using it restores Health, Chakra, and Stamina by 100 + six times its level, each over 30 seconds. It does not cure status effects. Use 'eat 2.pill' or 'use 2.pill' to select the second matching pill.

Date: 2026-09-27

Restorative medical items (Healing Salves, Soldier Pills, Medicinal Pills, and other healing medicine) cannot be used or eaten during PvE or PvP combat. Only ONE restorative medical treatment can be active at a time: a second item is not consumed and cannot start another heal until the first finishes, including after reconnecting. Healing already started before combat keeps its normal duration. Cure-only Antidote Pills do not restore resources and can still cure poison during combat or an active treatment.
